verdict: Fixed: AWSConnectionModelJSON fields Name and IsRoleAnywhere are now *string/*bool with omitempty (schema_connections.go:137,145), so json.Marshal omits them when nil; the Update() function never sets these fields, meaning neither 'name:""' nor 'is_role_anywhere:false' will appear in the PATCH body, eliminating both the 400 (name immutable) and 422 (IsRoleAnywhere cannot be updated) errors reported in the ticket.
